title: Complete Directory of Hospital Wings
definition: Every hospital organizes care into specialized wings: Emergency, ICU, Surgery, Pediatrics, Oncology, Cardiology, Radiology, Maternity, Neurology, Orthopedics, Pharmacy, Laboratory, Rehabilitation, Psychiatry, Outpatient Clinics, Transplant, Burn Unit, Neonatal ICU, Geriatrics, Dialysis, Gastroenterology, OB/GYN, Pulmonology, Endocrinology, Infectious Disease, Dermatology, Ophthalmology, ENT, Urology, and Rheumatology. Each wing has its own purpose, equipment, staff, and patient flow. Together they form the complete hospital organism.
patient_flow: Patients enter through the Emergency Department or scheduled admission and move between wings as their condition requires, with structured handoffs at every transition and a unified care plan visible to all teams.
code_demo:
def find_wing(wings, keyword):
    """Searches the all-wings directory for the right wing by keyword."""
    return [w for w in wings if keyword.lower() in w.lower()]
WINGS = ["Emergency Department","Intensive Care Unit","Surgery / Operating Rooms","Pediatrics",
"Oncology","Cardiology","Radiology / Imaging","Maternity / Labor & Delivery","Neurology",
"Orthopedics","Pharmacy","Laboratory / Pathology","Rehabilitation / Therapy",
"Psychiatric / Behavioral Health","Outpatient Clinics","Transplant","Burn Unit",
"Neonatal ICU","Geriatrics","Dialysis","Gastroenterology","OB/GYN","Pulmonology",
"Endocrinology","Infectious Disease","Dermatology","Ophthalmology","ENT","Urology","Rheumatology"]
print(find_wing(WINGS, "heart"))
teaching: Simple: the core idea in plain words — what it is and why it matters.
